items.title: Web Manga 'Funsou deshitara Hatta made' Gets TV Anime
items.summary: Publishing company Kodansha announced a television anime adaptation of Motohiro Den's Funsou deshitara Hatta made (If It's a Conflict, Leave it to Hatta) web manga on Monday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured).
